# Public

> > Public is an investing platform offering brokerage accounts with mobile and web access for retail investors.

Public provides a social investing experience where users can trade stocks, ETFs, and other securities. The platform emphasizes transparency and community-driven investing with educational resources and account management tools.

## Key Topics

- Public brokerage platform
- Account number lookup
- Mobile app navigation
- Brokerage account management
- Account help and support
- Investment accounts
- Trading platform
- Retail investing
- Account settings
- User account access
